Download the CurseForge app, search for “Linggango,” and click Install.
When the install is complete, click Play to launch Minecraft with the modpack.
Make sure to go to CurseForge settings --> Launch Settings --> and disable the Mojang Launcher.
Full details: see Installation Guide
Launch Linggango from CurseForge, click "Create New World," and prepare for adventure!
